ranked.headline: Learned models couple histology, omics, and spatial data to tumor endpoints
ranked.summary: Multimodal models now reach biomarker selection, spatial immune profiling, ctDNA deconvolution, and cross-modal data synthesis across tumor datasets.

ranked.headline: Metabolic network models linking dynamics, spectra, and microbial competition
ranked.summary: Recent papers couple metabolic network models with generative inference, reservoir computing, and Raman spectra to predict cellular state.

ranked.headline: Structural prediction of protein interactions across disorder, complexes and proteomes
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 work benchmarks AlphaFold-Multimer complex prediction and scales residue-level interaction maps to whole proteomes.

ranked.headline: Single-cell projection of trait heritability onto disease-remodeled cell states
ranked.summary: Single-cell atlases now span millions of cells, enabling trait, drug-response and perturbation effects to be resolved to specific cell populations and genes.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models predict chromatin binding and accessibility across species
ranked.summary: Recent work applies cross-species and sequence-based prediction to ChIP-seq binding, accessibility, and 3D genome organization, benchmarked against measured…

ranked.headline: Open tools package established peptide, ortholog and mixed-model methods
ranked.summary: Four April 2026 preprints and publications release lightweight tools wrapping established matching, mixed-model, and ortholog methods.

ranked.headline: Generative models steered by RL, search, and conditioning for protein and molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair conditioned generators with optimization to target specific design objectives in drug discovery and protein engineering.

ranked.headline: Graph and attention models for molecular prediction add interpretability checks
ranked.summary: Graph-based deep learning for molecular prediction is beginning to face direct tests of whether attributions reflect chemically meaningful sites.

ranked.headline: Metabolic models and metabolome searches enable reasoning over organism networks
ranked.summary: Curated metabolic models, kinetic workflows, and public metabolomics search are converging with LLM reasoning over sample-specific networks.

ranked.headline: Noise and feedback shape stochastic fate and fixation in evolving cell populations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published germinal center model extend stochastic evolutionary theory to microbial and cellular fate.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics registered to imaging maps brain zonation and vascularization
ranked.summary: Imaging-coupled spatial atlases now resolve tissue zonation and postnatal developmental phases at organ scale.

ranked.headline: Generative single-cell models predict expression under perturbation and across modalities
ranked.summary: Flow matching, conditional VAEs, and foundation-model embeddings are now being tested for robustness across conditions, modalities, and layers.

ranked.headline: ML models predict immune recognition across antibodies, TCR-pMHC and HLA presentation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply sequence-structure fusion, transformers and active learning to immune recognition targets, adding shortcut-bias diagnostics.

ranked.headline: Docking, MD and glycan-aware filters prioritize designed and biosynthetic candidates
ranked.summary: Structure-based scoring is being applied to genome mining, binder design, and DNA-encoded library screening, testing where predictions generalize.

ranked.headline: Learned and physics-informed models advance molecular property and binding prediction
ranked.summary: A new survey and benchmark of deep learning for molecular property prediction arrives alongside studies extending QM-AI, free-energy and repurposing workflows.

ranked.headline: Restrained and descriptor-guided MD map aggregation-prone states in amyloid-β and DPF3
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple simulation with NMR restraints, ensemble descriptors, or sequence predictors to target amyloid aggregation.

ranked.headline: Calibrating indel predictors and dosage metrics for clinical variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Indel calibration and structural variant dosage metrics extend variant interpretation beyond standard missense frameworks.

ranked.headline: Spatial omics methods test cell neighborhood and mRNA localization statistically
ranked.summary: Multi-sample spatial omics datasets call for inferential frameworks that model design, sample hierarchy, and spatial dependence explicitly.

ranked.headline: Structure-based models prioritize ligands and binders with measured performance
ranked.summary: Pose datasets, proteome-scale docking, and learned models are now benchmarked against measured binding outcomes.

ranked.headline: Protein language models predict phage tail fibers and depolymerase host specificity
ranked.summary: Two April 2026 published studies apply ESM-based protein language models to phage-host prediction, alongside metabolic-model work on pathogens.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in tool documentation and containerized execution for omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply LLM agents with explicit tool documentation, containers, and declarative configs to bioinformatics and immune profiling workflows.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings of RNA, drug and gene sequences drive new predictive models
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks and extends learned biomolecular representations, from text-derived gene embeddings to RNA foundation models.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose ambiguity and metric limits in RNA-seq and nanopore inference tools
ranked.summary: Published and preprint benchmarks now report uncertainty, joint quantification and metric limits rather than single-score rankings of sequencing tools.

ranked.headline: Multi-agent LLM systems grounding biological queries in knowledge graphs and retrieval
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply graph-grounded LLM agents to GPCR biology, GEO metadata, and biomedical data integration, alongside a UK Biobank benchmark.

ranked.headline: Interactive tools link gene hierarchy, sample trendlines and feature synergy in omics
ranked.summary: Queryable interfaces now expose gene hierarchy, sample trendlines and pairwise feature synergy from multi-omics data.

ranked.headline: Long-read and harmonized resources uncover genomic variation beyond the reference
ranked.summary: Long-read and copy number-aware methods now resolve mtDNA, Y chromosome, KIR, and canine variation that reference-anchored approaches may miss.

ranked.headline: Generative models infer molecular structures and benchmark data from mass spectrometry
ranked.summary: Structure-informed generative models now predict metabolite structures directly from MS2 spectra, backed by large, continuously reprocessed benchmark resources.

ranked.headline: Graph databases hold population genomic variants and compute summary statistics in one…
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair graph-database storage and statistics for population genomics with faster VCF filtering and variant annotation tools.

ranked.headline: Scalable platforms pair perturbations with imaging and chromatin readouts
ranked.summary: Automated platforms now scale 3D genome, imaging, and single-cell perturbation readouts to chemical or genome-wide screens.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneous priors and cross-consistency checks inform protein and RNA model scoring
ranked.summary: Three recent items extend learned sequence, structure, and evolutionary priors to model accuracy estimation, nucleic acid binding-site prediction, and RNA…

ranked.headline: MD suggests nsp10 activation of SARS-CoV-2 nsp16; N-glycans tune HIV-1 Env tilting
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom simulations and AI/ML analyses probe activation and membrane-engagement mechanisms in viral and mycobacterial systems at atomic resolution.

ranked.headline: MS pipelines map prokaryotic glycosylation and microbial nucleotide sugar precursors
ranked.summary: Two April 2026 preprints present untargeted MS-based platforms for mapping prokaryotic glycosylation and microbial sugar precursors.

ranked.headline: Genomic language models show limited regulatory gains over random baselines
ranked.summary: Pretraining objectives, data construction, and generated features are now being tested as explicit levers on sequence-model performance.

ranked.headline: Deep generative models learn conformational distributions beyond single static structures
ranked.summary: Generative samplers are being tested on molecular conformational distributions, including Trp-cage and α-synuclein dihedrals and cryo-EM synthetic data.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models couple Golgi transport, enzymatic waves and bacterial lineage…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize Golgi cisternal progression, enzymatic wave propagation and bacterial lineage dynamics as explicit dynamical models.

ranked.headline: Conductance models tie ion channel flux to neuronal and network excitability
ranked.summary: Recent models extend ion flux analysis from single-cell bursting to chloride-driven seizure transitions at network scale.

ranked.headline: Regulatory activity read through genetic variation, methylation and 3D chromatin context
ranked.summary: Cross-species atlases and pseudogene catalogs now place regulatory elements against genetic, methylation and chromatin context across tissues and development.

ranked.headline: Minimal models link adhesion, detachment, and polarity noise to migration limits
ranked.summary: Non-local, Voronoi, and stochastic polarity models now isolate mechanical and noise constraints on collective and single-cell migration.

ranked.headline: Microbial sequence and abundance data drive new inference and workflow methods
ranked.summary: Installable plugins, packages and workflows now deliver compositional, k-mer and metagenomic methods with explicit benchmarking and statistical evaluation.
